questions.question: Sofia Coppola’s Lost in Translation (2003) is set in which city?
questions.note: Bill Murray and Scarlett Johansson, mostly in and around the Park Hyatt Tokyo.

questions.question: Slumdog Millionaire is set in which Indian city?
questions.note: 2008, directed by Danny Boyle. Jamal’s quiz-show run is rooted in his childhood there.

questions.question: The 2008 Colin Farrell dark comedy In Bruges is set in which country?
questions.note: Bruges is a canal city in Flanders. Brendan Gleeson co-stars; Martin McDonagh wrote and directed.

questions.question: The musical Mamma Mia! (2008) is set on an island in which country?
questions.note: Filmed largely on Skopelos. Meryl Streep, Amanda Seyfried, and Pierce Brosnan.

questions.question: Alexander Payne’s The Descendants (2011), starring George Clooney, is set in which U.S. state?
questions.note: Clooney plays a Honolulu lawyer managing land and a family crisis. Shailene Woodley co-stars.

questions.question: Bong Joon-ho’s Parasite (2019) is set in which city?
questions.note: The Parks’ hillside house versus the Kims’ semi-basement. Busan is the other famous Korean film city.

questions.question: Saving Private Ryan’s central mission takes the squad into which 1944 campaign?
questions.note: After the Omaha Beach landing. Spielberg, 1998; Tom Hanks as Captain Miller.

questions.question: Leonardo DiCaprio’s 2000 survival drama The Beach is set primarily in which country?
questions.note: From Alex Garland’s novel. Much of it was shot on Ko Phi Phi Le.

questions.question: The 2002 musical Chicago is set in which decade?
questions.note: Jazz-age Chicago, with Renée Zellweger, Catherine Zeta-Jones, and Richard Gere. Rob Marshall directed.

questions.question: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon (2000) is set in which country?
questions.note: Ang Lee’s wuxia epic, in Mandarin. Chow Yun-fat, Michelle Yeoh, and Zhang Ziyi. It was a Taiwanese-Chinese co-production.
